altitude.quote: 72° N, 38° W at an elevation of 10,530 feet (3200 meters) above sea level.

coordinates.quote: located at 72°35'46" N, 38°25'19" W at the peak of the Greenland ice cap, atop more than 3 km of glacial ice, with a ~100 m deep firn layer

summary.plain: A grid of buried radio antenna stations on top of the Greenland ice sheet, more than three kilometres above the rock below, near the Summit Station research camp.
summary.technical: RNO-G array site at the peak of the Greenland ice cap, 72°35'46"N 38°25'19"W, atop >3 km of glacial ice with a ~100 m firn layer; stations laid out on a 1.25 km grid near Summit Station (elevation 3200 m).
